mike: Heads up — saw a regression on TP all-reduce throughput in the 2.3.1 runtime build.

jess: repro link?

mike: https://perf/reports/1962104321
mike: Quick summary: when model splits across TP=4, small reduce sizes (~8KB) suddenly drop throughput ~30% and increase tail latency. nvprof snapshot attached (pseudo):

```
[trace] 12:34:56 GPU0 allreduce start size=8192 peers=4 mode=ring
[trace] ncclFragment send=2048 count=4 chunks=4
[trace] kernel memcpy HtoD stall 120us
[trace] cudaSync wait 300us
```

olivia: interesting — are we falling back to tree topology for some ranks? that would increase syncs.

mike: yes — scheduler switches to tree when message >= 64KB, but we sometimes flip per-iteration due to fragmentation. for small msgs tree causes many short ops and extra kernel launches.

ryan: could be KV cache churn — small prefix cache misses produce many tiny KV updates so allreduce pattern is fragmented.

mike: confirmed. traces show frequent tiny updates from kvcache invalidation on generation boundaries. also kernel selection picks a launch with small grid leading to poor occupancy.

jess: proposed quick fixes:
- bump allreduce_min_bytes to 16KB
- add per-batch coalesce: coalesce_small_fragments=true
- force ring for msg_size < 32KB

olivia: also try increasing kernel batch_size threshold for small-grid kernels, e.g. kernels.small_grid_min_elems=4096

ryan: I'll try a runtime patch that merges adjacent small allreduces within the same microbatch window. simple heuristic: if pending_bytes < 32KB, wait up to 200us for more fragments (configurable).

mike: sounds good. if we add wait, need to ensure we don't violate token latency SLO. 200us seems safe for most long gen workloads.

perf-bot: CI perf run queued: job/infra/1962104321-smallmsg-coalesce

jess: test plan: run 50 warmups, then measure tokens/s and p99 latency across 10 seeds for TP=4/8 with kvcache on/off.

olivia: also capture nvtx ranges + nccl topo to check whether we still get kernel stalls.

mike: thanks. attaching a small reproducer below (python):

```
# repro snippet
for step in range(100):
    input = rand_tokens(batch=1, seq=512)
    out = model.generate(input, tp=4, kvcache=True)
```

ryan: started a local run with coalesce patch. will report numbers in ~30m :hourglass_flowing_sand: 

mike: :thumbsup: keep logs and nvprof dumps.

jess: if this passes, we'll roll patch to canary then dedicated clusters.

olivia: FYI — adding an observability metric: allreduce_fragment_count per request would make this visible in console.

mike: agreed. tagging this for release notes under "runtime: reduce fragmentation mitigation" if fixed.

ryan: update: preliminary results: tokens/s +18%, p99 -12% with 200us coalesce and 16KB threshold. full numbers next.

mike: awesome. once full CI confirms we'll merge.
